scope: Keep LTYPE DXF group-75 shape numbers within the signed 16-bit value range represented by DXF; retain the DWG payload domain unchanged.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: The DXF parser and DRW_LType::validateDxf admitted group-75 values through 65535 even though group 75 is in the 60-79 range encoded as a 16-bit integer. The typed writer emits group 75 with writeInt16, which rejects values outside the signed 16-bit range. DWG validatePayloadFields uses a separate unsigned-16-bit carrier and remains unchanged.

normativeEvidence.source: Autodesk AutoCAD 2024 Group Code Value Types Reference
normativeEvidence.relevantRule: Group codes 60-79 are 16-bit integer values; group 75 belongs to this range.
LTYPE group 75 is the shape number for a complex linetype element when group 74 specifies an embedded shape.

implementationReadiness.change: The DXF parser reads group 75 into a temporary and accepts only 0..INT16_MAX before assignment. DXF typed validation enforces the same maximum before the writer can begin output. DWG payload validation retains its prior 0..UINT16_MAX range.

coverage: The parser accepts shape number 32767 in ASCII and Binary DXF and the typed LTYPE passes DXF validation.
The parser rejects negative shape-number values without changing the prior typed value; ASCII parsing also rejects 32768.
Typed ASCII and Binary writers emit shape number 32767 and refuse 32768 before emitting bytes.
DWG payload validation remains on its separate unsigned-16-bit domain.

limitations: Generated DXF numeric-width controls only; no physical LTYPE producer or native CAD interpretation was tested.
DWG shape-number layout and values are outside this DXF-only change.
No support claim is promoted; broader LTYPE profiles and P6 semantics remain open.
nextReadyPacket: Continue with another source-backed P6 local gap; retain strict separation between DXF signed group widths and DWG payload representations.
